lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨਨ ਸਰਨਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਬੰਦਨ ॥ ਸੁਖੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਹੀ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਪਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: charanan saranan sa(n)tan ba(n)dan || sukho sukh paahee || naanak tapat haree || mile prem piree ||3||3||143||
lines.translation: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet, and dedication to the Saints these bring me peace and pleasure. O Nanak, my burning fire has been put out, obtaining the Love of the Beloved. ||3||3||143||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਲੋਇਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurahi dikhaaio loinaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru has revealed Him to my eyes. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਤਹਿ ਊਤਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: eetahi ootahi ghat ghat ghat ghat too(n)hee too(n)hee mohinaa ||1||
lines.translation: Here and there, in each and every heart, and each and every being, You, O Fascinating Lord, You exist. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਧਾਰਨ ਧਰਨਾ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaaran karanaa dhaaran dharanaa ekai ekai sohinaa ||2||
lines.translation: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Support of the earth; You are the One and only, Beauteous Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਇਨਾ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tan parasan balihaaree darasan naanak sukh sukh soinaa ||3||4||144||
lines.translation: Meeting the Saints, and beholding the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, Nanak is a sacrifice to them; he sleeps in absolute peace. ||3||4||144||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam amolaa ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is priceless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu sahaj suhelaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: It brings peace and poise. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਓਹੁ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g sahaaee chhod na jaaee ohu agah atolaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord is my Companion and Helper; He shall not forsake me or leave me. He is unfathomable and unequalled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੋਰੋ ਮਾਈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਓਲੑਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: preetam bhaaee baap moro maaee bhagatan kaa olhaa ||2||
lines.translation: He is my Beloved, my brother, father and mother; He is the Support of His devotees. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਚੋਲੑਾ ॥੩॥੫॥੧੪੫॥
lines.transliteration: alakh lakhaaiaa gur te paaiaa naanak ihu har kaa cholhaa ||3||5||145||
lines.translation: The Invisible Lord is seen through the Guru; O Nanak, this is the wondrous play of the Lord. ||3||5||145||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapunee bhagat nibaahi ||
lines.translation: Please help me sustain my devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਆਇਓ ਆਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur aaio aahi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Lord Master, I have come to You. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਕਾਰਥੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath hoi sakaarath hiradai charan basaahi ||1||
lines.translation: With the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, life becomes fruitful. Lord, please place Your Feet within my heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਏਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: eh mukataa eh jugataa raakhahu sa(n)t sa(n)gaahi ||2||
lines.translation: This is liberation, and this is the best way of life; please, keep me in the Society of the Saints. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੪੬॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhiaavau sahaj samaavau naanak har gun gaahi ||3||6||146||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Naam, I am absorbed in celestial peace; O Nanak, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||6||146||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur charan suhaave ||
lines.translation: The Feet of my Lord and Master are so Beautiful!

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਵੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sa(n)tan paave ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Saints obtain them. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਗੁਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਵੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aap gavaaiaa sev kamaaiaa gun ras ras gaave ||1||
lines.translation: They eradicate their self-conceit and serve the Lord; drenched in His Love, they sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਸਾ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਭਾਵੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ekahi aasaa daras piaasaa aan na bhaave ||2||
lines.translation: They place their hopes in Him, and they thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Nothing else is pleasing to them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੇ ॥੩॥੭॥੧੪੭॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa tuhaaree kiaa ja(n)t vichaaree naanak bal bal jaave ||3||7||147||
lines.translation: This is Your Mercy, Lord; what can Your poor creatures do? Nanak is devoted, a sacrifice to You. ||3||7||147||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek simar man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Remember the One Lord in meditation within your mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhiaavahu ridai basaavahu tis bin ko naahee ||1||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and enshrine Him within your heart. Without Him there is no other. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: prabh saranee aaeeai sarab phal paaeeai sagale dukh jaahee ||2||
lines.translation: Entering God's Sanctuary, all rewards are obtained, and all pains are taken away. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਹੀ ॥੩॥੮॥੧੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: jeean ko daataa purakh bidhaataa naanak ghat ghat aahee ||3||8||148||
lines.translation: He is the Giver of all beings, the Architect of Destiny; O Nanak, He is contained in each and every heart. ||3||8||148||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸੋ ਮੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bisarat so mooaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who forgets the Lord is dead. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਹੂਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhiaavai sarab phal paavai so jan sukheeaa hooaa ||1||
lines.translation: One who meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtains all rewards. That person becomes happy. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਨਲਿਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raaj kahaavai hau karam kamaavai baadhio nalinee bhram sooaa ||2||
lines.translation: One who calls himself a king, and acts in ego and pride, is caught by his doubts, like a parrot in a trap. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥੯॥੧੪੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak jis satigur bhetiaa so jan nihachal theeaa ||3||9||149||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, one who meets the True Guru, becomes permanent and immortal. ||3||9||149||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 14 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Fourteenth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ॥ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu nehu navelaa || apune preetam siu laag rahai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: That love is forever fresh and new, Which is for the Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਚੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo prabh bhaavai janam na aavai || har prem bhagat har preet rachai ||1||
lines.translation: One who is pleasing to God shall not be reincarnated again. He remains absorbed in the loving devotional worship of the Lord, in the Love of the Lord. ||1||
